description: This file defines the interface ProductService, which provides methods for managing products within a sales or e-commerce application. It includes methods for adding descriptions, retrieving products by various criteria, listing products, and saving or updating product information.

classes.name: ProductService
classes.description: Service interface for product-related operations such as retrieval, listing, creation, and updating of products.

methods.name: addProductDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a product.

methods.name: getProductDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a product based on product and language.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a product tailored for a specific locale.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves products within a category for a specific locale.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products based on category IDs.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products available in a specific store, optionally with criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a product based on its SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Gets a product by its SKU/code.
